facts.note: Transcript: 'I would not show him mine' (watch at dinner); after dinner sat alone in dining room with brandy, heard temple strike ten, 'I did not look at my watch.'
Went out into the street to smoke at twenty-one minutes past ten by his watch, and stayed under the front windows of the house.
Piano started in the salon just as he lit his cigar, at twenty-nine minutes past ten by his watch.
At twenty-six minutes to eleven by his watch, heard faint quick bells from the master's window up above.
Came back into the house at fourteen minutes to eleven by his watch; hall clock had just struck eleven and its face showed two minutes past eleven; went straight up to Félix in the library.

added.quote: The piano started up in the salon just as I lit my cigar, at twenty-nine minutes past ten by my watch.
added.why: The sheet gives the piano starting at 10:29 but not where it was played; the transcript places the playing in the salon, so someone was in the salon at that moment.
